text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 101 से 103 तक ‘A Visit to Orchha’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 101 se 103 tak ‘A Visit to Orchha’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read ‘A Visit to Orchha’ on pages 101 to 103 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: Why were the students of class VII happy?

questionMeaning.hi: क्लास 7 के बच्चे ख़ुश क्यों थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Class 7 ke bachche khush kyon the?

options: They had visited Orchha and were discussing it.
steps.answer: They had visited Orchha and were discussing it.
steps.modelAnswer: The students of class VII were happy because they had visited Orchha and were excited to discuss their visit.

modelMeaning.hi: क्लास 7 के बच्चे ख़ुश थे क्योंकि वे ओरछा घूमकर आए थे और उसके बारे में बात करने को उत्साहित थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Class 7 ke bachche khush the kyonki woh Orchha ghoomkar aaye the aur uske baare mein baat karne ko utsaahit the.

steps.question: What is the meeting place of rivers called?

questionMeaning.hi: नदियों के मिलने की जगह को क्या कहते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Nadiyon ke milne ki jagah ko kya kehte hain?

steps.modelAnswer: The meeting place of rivers is called Sangam. In English it is called a confluence.

modelMeaning.hi: नदियों के मिलने की जगह को संगम कहते हैं। इंग्लिश में इसे confluence कहते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Nadiyon ke milne ki jagah ko sangam kehte hain. English mein ise confluence kehte hain.

steps.question: What is a cenotaph?
options: a monument built in memory of people who died in far away places
steps.answer: a monument built in memory of people who died in far away places
steps.modelAnswer: A cenotaph is a monument built in memory of soldiers, sailors or others who died in some far away places.

modelMeaning.hi: cenotaph उन लोगों की याद में बना स्मारक है जो कहीं दूर मरे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Cenotaph un logon ki yaad mein bana smaarak hai jo kahin door mare.

steps.question: What are the cenotaphs at Orchha called?

questionMeaning.hi: ओरछा के स्मारकों को क्या कहते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Orchha ke smaarakon ko kya kehte hain?

steps.modelAnswer: The cenotaphs at Orchha are called chhatries.

modelMeaning.hi: ओरछा के स्मारकों को छतरियाँ कहते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Orchha ke smaarakon ko chhatriyaan kehte hain.

steps.question: Who built the buildings at Orchha?
steps.modelAnswer: The Bundela kings built the buildings at Orchha.

modelMeaning.hi: ओरछा की इमारतें बुंदेला राजाओं ने बनवाईं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Orchha ki imaaratein Bundela raajaon ne banwaayin.

steps.question: Which style do the wall paintings at Orchha belong to?

questionMeaning.hi: ओरछा की दीवारों के चित्र किस शैली के हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Orchha ki deewaaron ke chitra kis shaili ke hain?

steps.modelAnswer: The wall paintings at Orchha belong to the Bundela style, a part of the Rajput style.

modelMeaning.hi: ओरछा के भित्ति चित्र बुंदेला शैली के हैं, जो राजपूत शैली का हिस्सा है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Orchha ke bhitti chitra Bundela shaili ke hain, jo Rajput shaili ka hissa hai.

steps.question: When were the wall paintings very popular?

questionMeaning.hi: दीवार के चित्र कब बहुत लोकप्रिय थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Deewaar ke chitra kab bahut lokpriya the?

steps.modelAnswer: Wall paintings were very popular in the 16th and 17th centuries.

modelMeaning.hi: दीवार के चित्र 16वीं और 17वीं सदी में बहुत लोकप्रिय थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Deewaar ke chitra 16vi aur 17vi sadi mein bahut lokpriya the.

steps.question: Who looks after old monuments and buildings?

questionMeaning.hi: पुराने स्मारकों की देखभाल कौन करता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Puraane smaarakon ki dekhbhaal kaun karta hai?

steps.modelAnswer: The Archaeological Department looks after old monuments and buildings.

modelMeaning.hi: पुरातत्व विभाग पुराने स्मारकों और इमारतों की देखभाल करता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Puraatatva vibhaag puraane smaarakon aur imaaraton ki dekhbhaal karta hai.
